items.title_zh: MOABB v1.7.1 发布
items.title_en: MOABB v1.7.1 Release
bullets_zh: NeuroTechX于2026年8月31日发布MOABB v1.7.1。
当NEMAR因代理或HTTP故障不可达时，它仍可使用本地缓存的上游数据集数据。
该版本在NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常，并保留auto provider回退。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX released MOABB v1.7.1 on 2026-08-31.
It keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through proxy or HTTP failures.
The release catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries and preserves auto provider fallback.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1发布，提升NEMAR不可达时的离线缓存可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 improves offline cached dataset availability when NEMAR is unreachable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

items.title_zh: MOABB：使数据集气泡图可复现（#1168）
items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168)
bullets_zh: MOABB提交#1168通过用显式random_state替换全局NumPy随机状态，使数据集气泡图可复现。
固定默认值确保重复调用生成相同图形，整数种子允许受控变化。
这提高了非侵入式EEG/BCI数据集比较中基准可视化的可靠性。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1168 makes dataset bubble plots reproducible by replacing global NumPy random state with explicit random_state.
A fixed default ensures repeated calls produce identical figures, while integer seeds allow controlled variation.
This improves reliability of benchmark visualizations for non-invasive EEG/BCI dataset comparisons.

items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter. items.title_zh: 在预取 NEMAR 前使用缓存数据（#1169）
items.title_en: Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169)
bullets_zh: MOABB 提交 #1169 更新基准测试流程，在预取 NEMAR 前使用缓存数据。
该变更避免对已缓存数据集进行不必要的 NEMAR 预取，并在移除缓存后保留 NEMAR 优先行为。
其意义在于 MOABB 支持非侵入式 BCI 基准评测，尤其是基于 EEG 的工作流。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1169 updates the benchmark pipeline to use cached data before prefetching NEMAR.
The change avoids unnecessary NEMAR prefetch for cached datasets and preserves NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal.
It matters because MOABB supports non-invasive BCI benchmark evaluation, especially EEG-based workflows.

items.raw_excerpt: Fix label leakage in BNCI2025_001, the montages gh-700 never shipped, and the NEMAR prefetch guard (#1161) - BNCI2025_001: type the 7 kinematic channels (target position, hand velocity) as misc. read_raw_eeglab typed them eeg, so every paradigm fed the labels to the classifier as features.
